correction.supersedes: revision 1 of this pack, which asserted the 11 questions were 'confirmed present on the source with content captured'

superseded_evidence.retracted_claim: that the 4 江苏2024A and 7 广东2020 gap numbers were '真实存在且可见' and '已被本次采集取得' — i.e. captured content
superseded_evidence.why_wrong: the aligner reported `no-safe-unique-match`, which was read as 'content differs'. It actually meant the source slot holds a collection stub, so there was nothing to match.

correction.what_actually_holds: at all 11 numbers the source page holds an uncollected collection stub; a question number or DOM container proves a slot exists, not that content was collected
correction.corroboration: the same stub string is what the pinned third-party references print at these numbers (verified in the PR #24 probe of 上岸通/展鸿/星光), so the two directions agree
correction.not_claimed: PR #33 corrects a misreading of the capture; it is NOT an official-paper certification of anything, and this pack does not present it as one

scope.statement: The 11 gap numbers. Their source slots exist but hold no content, so no repair is possible from the fenbi capture. Separate from the 江苏2025C backfill, which must not be overwritten.
